rationale: Logistic Regression is selected as the optimal credit risk model because it achieves the highest discriminative ranking power (Test ROC-AUC: 0.7532, 5-Fold CV AUC: 0.7426 ± 0.0063). In credit underwriting, raw accuracy is insufficient due to the 88.4% / 11.6% class imbalance. Logistic Regression provides superior probability calibration across borrower risk tiers, enabling precise identification of default risks while minimizing false rejections of creditworthy borrowers.
